transport: Ethernet, Wi-Fi client and Wi-Fi access point, Bluetooth; plus RV-C RJ-45 and 4-pin Molex, NMEA 2000 Micro-C, and an RS-485 Modbus RJ-45 port. Talks to a phone/tablet/PC app. No documented HTTP API, no port, no auth scheme, no Modbus register map published.
gotchas: This is the single highest-value target in the Xantrex line and the least documented one. It is the aggregation point for Freedom X/XC, Freedom XC PRO, Freedom EX 4000, Freedom SW RV-C, both Solar MPPT controllers, and the lithium batteries. If it exposed a LAN API you would get the whole system from one endpoint. Xant
It has an RS-485 Modbus RJ-45 port, but the datasheet does not say whether the Gateway is a Modbus master (polling the 60A controller) or a slave (answering an external master). Do not assume either.

Do not confuse the Xantrex Gateway (808-1888) with the Schneider Conext Gateway / InsightHome / InsightFacility, which does have a published Modbus map bundle. Different vendor branding, different product, no evidence of a shared map.
